help: usage: fleet-switchboard preflight-pr [-h] [--merged] [--body PR] Runs, each under the `heavy` wrapper and a time ceiling: the command-surface snapshot class, the hygiene and role-file classes, bin/check-public-names and, when files under cloud/ changed against the base, the cloud suites with TMPDIR a 49-character token-shaped directory name. Only runs tests: it never pushes, labels or records a verdict. With --merged the same classes run on a local merge of the base into the head (a temporary worktree, removed afterwards). options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --merged Run on a local merge of the current base into the head, so a change green alone and red against the moved base is found before the push --body PR Only read the pull request (owner/repo#N) and its plan: refuse a description whose first section is not the cause the plan's cause-first scenario asks for (writes nothing)
